description: Zone settings of joutiya.ma (§2, §6), applied in order by scripts/cloudflare.ts. ssl_automatic_mode=custom first, otherwise Automatic SSL/TLS may change the mode on its own. Email obfuscation and Rocket Loader off: both rewrite the HTML and inject a script the CSP would refuse. HSTS at the edge too, so responses Cloudflare answers itself (Access, rate-limit and error pages) carry it: 12 months (the longest the setting documents, enough for the preload list; the app sends 2 years on its own pages), subdomains included like the app header (every hostname of the zones is HTTPS: site, admin, staging, media, tunnels; notif is DNS-only mail records), nosniff left to the app (it already sends it).
